subject: Problem with margins option in facet_grid

messages.author: dadc1b2705a3e4ae
messages.subject: Problem with margins option in facet_grid
parts:
Hello,

I have a problem with the following example:

> library(ggplot2)
Loading required package: reshape
Loading required package: plyr

Attaching package: 'reshape'

The following object(s) are masked from 'package:plyr':

round_any

Loading required package: grid
Loading required package: proto
> p <- ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, ..density..)) +
+ geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2)
> p + facet_grid(cut ~ clarity, margins=TRUE)
Error in class(output[[var]]) <- class(value) :
cannot set class to "array" unless the dimension attribute has
length > 0

Did I miss something with this option?

Thank you very much for any help.

david
